# Feature Workstation first in all Portal example modes

## Context

The operator found that all four manually curated Portal example catalogs feature the small choreography example rather than the release's Workstation app. At `af539a9f0c3e9fb8eca2051de98ff41867d724a6`, each list starts with `id:28` (`examples/dashboard/choreography`); the existing Workstation record `id:27` is third. The current covers were also visually inspected: the choreography card uses an old Workstation frame with overlapping controls, and the Workstation image is cropped.

## The Problem

A first-time visitor is directed to the wrong featured experience, while two prominent cards appear to represent the same product. HTTP 200 and successful mounting did not establish that the featured card opened the intended app.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/portal/resources/data/examples_{devmode,dist_dev,dist_esm,dist_prod}.json` are curated source data, not generated files.
- `apps/portal/store/Examples.mjs` preserves the catalog order; `view/examples/List.mjs` renders that order and consumes `sharedWorkers` for the badge/navigation behavior.
- The existing Workstation record already has distinct correct source/development/ESM/production URLs. Its app config enables SharedWorkers, but the catalog flag is missing.
- `List.mjs#imageBasePath` serves covers from Pages `resources_pub/website/examples/`, not the Engine image-original directory. Both the source originals and actual Pages-hosted assets must be carried through publication.

Design authority: the operator's 2026-10-12 correction names `apps/workstation` as the intended featured destination; the small example must move down “a lot” if retained, and the old cover with styling glitches must be replaced.

## The Fix

Promote the existing Workstation record to first in all four catalogs, preserving its stable id and correct mode URLs; declare its SharedWorker capability. Move the focused choreography example to the end of the visible catalog and name it “Dock Choreography Demo”. Preserve every unrelated entry and URL.

Capture fresh, clean screenshots of the actual current apps for their distinct covers. Retain the source originals under the existing example-image directory and hand the exact artifacts to the Pages publisher. No generator, engine layout code, or new abstraction is needed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] All four first records are the existing Workstation entry, with the four correct mode URLs and `sourceUrl: apps/workstation`.
- [x] Choreography appears once, last among visible entries, clearly named; unrelated entries and stable ids remain intact.
- [x] Both referenced cover originals are fresh captures of the corresponding current app, visually checked without the reported glitches or truncation.
- [x] The first-card destination is verified as the actual Workstation UI in each mode, not only HTTP status or a generic mounted application.
